facts.text: Portrait Roma is set above Via Condotti, steps from Piazza di Spagna and Trinità dei Monti, overlooking the rooftops of the city.
facts.excerpt: Set above Via Condotti, just steps from Piazza di Spagna and Trinità dei Monti, Portrait Roma is a beautiful Roman residence overlooking the rooftops of the city.

facts.text: The hotel was designed by Michele Bönan and inspired by the world of Salvatore Ferragamo.
facts.excerpt: Designed by Michele Bönan and inspired by the world of Salvatore Ferragamo

facts.text: Portrait Roma has a rooftop terrace with panoramic views.
facts.excerpt: A rooftop terrace with panoramic views completes the atmosphere of discreet elegance

facts.text: Portrait Roma is pet friendly.
facts.excerpt: Portrait Roma is pet friendly.

facts.text: Portrait Roma is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World.
facts.excerpt: Portrait Roma is proud member of The Leading Hotels of the World.

facts.text: The suites combine living areas, private terraces and discreet kitchenettes, in the style of an elegant Roman home.
facts.excerpt: Living areas, private terraces and discreet kitchenette create the atmosphere of an elegant Roman home

facts.text: Breakfast centres on Italian specialties and carefully selected ingredients.
facts.excerpt: Breakfast centres around Italian specialties and carefully selected ingredients

facts.text: Throughout the day the terrace is a setting for coffee, aperitivi or a glass of wine above Rome.
facts.excerpt: throughout the day the terrace becomes a natural setting for coffee, aperitivi or a glass of wine above Rome.

facts.text: The hotel's address is Via Bocca di Leone 23, 00187 Rome.
facts.excerpt: Via Bocca di Leone, 23 00187 Rome - Italy

facts.text: Portrait Roma holds 1 MICHELIN Key in the Guida MICHELIN Hotels 2026.
facts.excerpt: Guida MICHELIN Hotels 2026 ### 1 Chiave MICHELIN

facts.text: Ferragamo memorabilia, including vintage shoe molds, hand-drawn designs and photographs of celebrity muses, line the corridors and staircases.
facts.excerpt: vintage shoe molds, hand-drawn designs, and photographs of celebrity muses line the corridors and staircases

facts.text: The Via Condotti Suite is designed like a one-bedroom apartment.
facts.excerpt: Via Condotti Suite, designed like a one-bedroom apartment with everything you’d need to live in

facts.text: In the Via Condotti Suite, wooden doors in the foyer hide a kitchenette with a cooking range.
facts.excerpt: In the foyer, a giant set of wooden doors reveals a surprise: not just hidden snack drawers and a fridge, but an entire kitchenette complete with a cooking range.

facts.text: The Trinità dei Monti Penthouse Suite comes with a private terrace, a tiny gym and a sauna.
facts.excerpt: Trinità dei Monti Penthouse Suite, which comes with a private terrace, tiny gym, and sauna.

facts.text: There is no full-service restaurant; breakfast is served on the rooftop, indoors or out on the terrace.
facts.excerpt: There isn’t a full-service restaurant here, so breakfast is the main meal, served on the rooftop, either indoors or out on the terrace.

facts.text: The concierge can procure a meal from a guest's favorite restaurant and serve it on the terrace.
facts.excerpt: the concierge is more than happy to procure a meal from your favorite restaurant and serve it to you on the terrace.

facts.text: The lifestyle team offers tailor-made itineraries for discovering Rome.
facts.excerpt: The lifestyle team also offers a roster of tailor-made itineraries designed to help you discover the Eternal City

facts.text: Guests can go shopping with a personal stylist or take a food-shopping trip to Campo de' Fiori followed by a cooking class.
facts.excerpt: Go shopping with a personal stylist, or opt for a food-shopping trip to Campo de’ Fiori followed by a cooking class.

facts.text: The rooftop has a fireplace for the winter months.
facts.excerpt: as well as a fireplace for winter months

facts.text: Because it is a small, historic townhouse, fully accessible room inventory is extremely limited; check with staff when booking.
facts.excerpt: Because it is a small, historic townhouse, fully accessible or ADA-compliant room inventory is extremely limited—check with staff when booking.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler rates it family friendly but more suitable to older kids.
facts.excerpt: Yes, but more suitable to older kids

facts.text: The hotel is owned by the Ferragamo family's Lungarno Collection, which has hotels in Florence and Milan.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is owned by Ferragamo family's Lungarno Collection with outposts in Florence and Milan.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler lists no wellness facilities at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Wellness: No

facts.text: The hotel is a short walk from the Spanish Steps and around the corner from the Six Senses and Hotel de Russie.
facts.excerpt: A skip away from the Spanish Steps, around the corner from the Six Senses and Hotel de Russie
